info.title: Uyaras Commerce API
info.description: V1 preview. Amounts are integer INR paise. Collections return items/total/page/page_size/pages. Mutations require the session cookie and X-CSRF-Token. Production ordering remains locked.

announcement.title: Announcement
announcement.default: A little blue. A little slower. Made for your everyday.

hero_text.title: Hero Text
hero_text.default: Easy silhouettes. Quiet colours. A softer kind of everyday.

returns_policy.title: Returns Policy
returns_policy.default: Preview policy: request a return within 14 days. Items must be unworn with tags. Final terms pending.

shipping_policy.title: Shipping Policy
shipping_policy.default: Preview only. Delivery coverage and dispatch estimates are not yet confirmed.

cancellation_policy.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellation_policy.default: Preview policy: cancellation before dispatch; paid cancellations require a recorded refund.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.default: Development preview. Use fictional personal information only. Production privacy terms pending.

terms.title: Terms
terms.default: Uyaras preview: products, prices and checkout are demonstrations. No purchases are fulfilled.

refund_policy.title: Refund Policy
refund_policy.default: Preview policy: approved refunds are recorded against the original order after manual review. Final refund timelines and methods are pending.
